metadata.question: Does the extent of burn scars in the Flint Hills region of eastern Kansas increase on April 8, 2023, compared to March 19, 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized (primary), fallback to Landsat 8/9 L2 SR if needed.
- Location: Approximate Flint Hills ROI in eastern Kansas (bounding box).
- Dates: March 19, 2023 and April 8, 2023 with ±3 days window; if empty, widen to ±10 days.

2. Masking strategy.
- Mask clouds/cirrus using QA bands for S2 and Landsat.
- Remove permanent water using JRC Global Surface Water occurrence > 50%.
- Compute NBR and NDVI; classify burned where NBR < 0.1 AND NDVI < 0.5.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error.
- If collection size 0 after attempts => C1.
- If valid pixel count after masking is 0 for either date => C2.
- If reduction results are null/NaN => C3.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
      [[[-97.7, 36.9], [-97.7, 39.8], [-95.0, 39.8], [-95.0, 36.9]]],
      null, false
    );
    const dateA = '2023-03-19';
    const dateB = '2023-04-08';

    // Global masks
    const water = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater').select('occurrence').gt(50);
    const notWater = water.not();

    // Helpers
    const getInfoAsync = (obj) =>
      new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));

    function maskS2SR(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10;
      const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11;
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
      return img.updateMask(mask).divide(10000)
        .select(['B8','B12','B4','B3','B11'], ['NIR','SWIR2','RED','GREEN','SWIR1']);
    }

    function s2Collection(start, end) {
      return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(roi)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80))
        .map(maskS2SR);
    }

    function maskLandsatL2(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // dilated cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)) // cirrus
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0)) // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); // cloud shadow
      const sr = img.updateMask(mask);
      const scaled = sr.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'])
        .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      return scaled.select(
        ['SR_B5','SR_B7','SR_B4','SR_B3','SR_B6'],
        ['NIR','SWIR2','RED','GREEN','SWIR1']
      );
    }

    function landsatCollection(start, end) {
      const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2');
      const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2');
      return l8.merge(l9)
        .filterBounds(roi)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 90))
        .map(maskLandsatL2);
    }

    async function buildCompositeForDate(dateStr) {
      const d = ee.Date(dateStr);
      // Try Sentinel-2 ±3 days
      let start = d.advance(-3, 'day');
      let end = d.advance(3, 'day').advance(1, 'day'); // inclusive
      let col = s2Collection(start, end);
      let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      let sensor = 'S2';
      let meanCloud = null;
      if (size === 0) {
        // widen to ±10
        start = d.advance(-10, 'day');
        end = d.advance(10, 'day').advance(1, 'day');
        col = s2Collection(start, end);
        size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      }
      if (size === 0) {
        // fallback to Landsat ±10
        col = landsatCollection(start, end);
        size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
        sensor = 'Landsat';
      }
      if (size === 0) {
        return {status: 'C1'};
      }
      // Cloudiness metadata (best-effort)
      if (sensor === 'S2') {
        meanCloud = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(col.aggregate_mean('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE')));
      } else {
        meanCloud = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(col.aggregate_mean('CLOUD_COVER')));
      }
      const comp = col.median().clip(roi);
      const ndvi = comp.normalizedDifference(['NIR','RED']).rename('NDVI');
      const nbr = comp.normalizedDifference(['NIR','SWIR2']).rename('NBR');
      const img = comp.addBands([ndvi, nbr]);
      return {status: 'OK', image: img, sensor, nImgs: size, meanCloud};
    }

    async function computeMetrics(img) {
      const scale = 1000;
      const nbr = img.select('NBR');
      const ndvi = img.select('NDVI');
      const burn = nbr.lt(0.1).and(ndvi.lt(0.5)).and(notWater);
      const validCount = await getInfoAsync(
        nbr.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e10
        }).get('NBR')
      );
      if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
        return {status: 'C2'};
      }
      const burnCount = await getInfoAsync(
        ee.Image(1).updateMask(burn).rename('one').reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e10
        }).get('one')
      );
      const areaM2 = await getInfoAsync(
        ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(burn).reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e10
        }).get('area')
      );
      if (areaM2 === null || areaM2 === undefined) {
        return {status: 'C3'};
      }
      const areaKm2 = areaM2 / 1e6;
      return {status: 'OK', validCount, burnCount: burnCount || 0, areaKm2};
    }

    // Build composites
    const compA = await buildCompositeForDate(dateA);
    if (compA.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(`Mar19: ${compA.status}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    const compB = await buildCompositeForDate(dateB);
    if (compB.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(`Apr08: ${compB.status}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Metrics
    const metA = await computeMetrics(compA.image);
    if (metA.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(`Mar19: ${metA.status}`);
      console.log(metA.status);
      return;
    }
    const metB = await computeMetrics(compB.image);
    if (metB.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(`Apr08: ${metB.status}`);
      console.log(metB.status);
      return;
    }

    // Print concise evidence (<=20 lines)
    console.log(`Mar19 Sensor=${compA.sensor}, Images=${compA.nImgs}, MeanCloud=${(compA.meanCloud!==null)?compA.meanCloud.toFixed(1):'NA'}%`);
    console.log(`Mar19 ValidPix=${metA.validCount}, BurnPix=${metA.burnCount}, BurnArea_km2=${metA.areaKm2.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Apr08 Sensor=${compB.sensor}, Images=${compB.nImgs}, MeanCloud=${(compB.meanCloud!==null)?compB.meanCloud.toFixed(1):'NA'}%`);
    console.log(`Apr08 ValidPix=${metB.validCount}, BurnPix=${metB.burnCount}, BurnArea_km2=${metB.areaKm2.toFixed(1)}`);
    const delta = metB.areaKm2 - metA.areaKm2;
    console.log(`DeltaArea_km2=${delta.toFixed(1)}`);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if (!isFinite(metA.areaKm2) || !isFinite(metB.areaKm2)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    // Decide increase: require strictly greater by at least 1% of Mar19 burned area or 10 km2 (to avoid noise)
    const thresh = Math.max(10, metA.areaKm2 * 0.01);
    const answer = (delta > thresh) ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${String(err).slice(0,200)}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
